summary.text: Ryan Guillen is a Republican member of the Texas House of Representatives who has represented District 31 since 2003 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He announced on November 15, 2021 that he was leaving the Democratic Party to run as a Republican.

paragraphs.text: Ryan Guillen earned a B.S. from Texas A&M University in College Station.
Ballotpedia says he has worked as a businessman, investor and rancher.
Guillen first assumed office in 2003, and his current term ends on January 12, 2027.
He chaired the Culture, Recreation & Tourism Committee in the 2011-2015 sessions and chaired Resolutions Calendars in 2019-2022.
In 2023-2024 he chaired the Homeland Security & Public Safety Committee and also served on House State Affairs.
